scope: History viewport continuity; requested by user
result: Baseline affine formula is correct. PCHIP recomputes existing terminal intervals on append, so affine-only animation leaves visible discontinuities. Match actual presentation controls by exact timestamp interval and preserve departure context.
adopted: Baseline viewport transform and matched local control interpolation, bounded Core Animation, presentation retarget, paired fill and head, fixed viewport clipping.
boundary: Reviewer proposed an alternative using per-frame viewport-space controls. This implementation retains the minimum hybrid affine/control approach and is verified separately on macOS; a Pro opinion alone is not runtime evidence.
